metadata.duplicate_rule: stable first original row at each time; no performance-based selection
stable first original row at each time; no performance-based selection

environment.runtime: existing rootless bubblewrap Noetic, isolated network/ROS, raw bag single-file readonly

clock.matching_policy: match by exact standard header timestamp within 1e-6s; custom stream begins 21 rows earlier, no index pairing

protocol.history: R2 metrics and service budget formulated after R1 outcomes were known
protocol.normal_cost: best robust natural RMSE + max(2%,0.05m), all controls included in unqualified tables
protocol.extended_rule: evaluate every method on same full expected grid; retain missing/partial status; no successful intersection
protocol.t_return: first actually present sensor observation after deletion end
protocol.t_admit: first accepted KF update after t_return; right censor at fixed 180s observation window
protocol.bias_risk: injected-row acceptance is a stress risk proxy, never field wrong-GNSS probability
protocol.latency_clock: primary: measurement_sow of accepted update; separately report available_sow conservative bound; neither is measured wall-clock arrival
protocol.deadline_boundary_rule: inclusive on measurement-clock latency, 1e-8s tolerance; availability-bound eligibility reported separately
protocol.event_aggregation: equal-weight per-event RMSE macro; no successful-only removal
protocol.clock_alias: P_time_only at good_duration_s=2 is exactly Clock2
protocol.hypothesis_gate: H2 requires risk reduction and error reduction versus every fast normal-cost-qualified baseline; H3 requires independent new route and attribution
protocol.reference_role: time/schema only plus one earliest common-covered reference state before freeze, remaining states only offline after exact remote verification
protocol.unsupported_event_rule: block complete primary matrix; do not advance/reselect by method error
protocol.coverage_gate: complete expected whole route and all five windows; no successful intersection
protocol.scientific_effect_requirement: same original15s/natural/coverage joint gates per route, plus descriptive P vs Clock2 and no-anchor; report all route/event signs and stronger baselines; no universal or novelty inference
protocol.event_support: fixed offsets from common sensor-reference initialization, audit lower bound from first usable GNSS/IMU and validate again at actual cache-covered init before freeze
protocol.measurement_maximum: whole horizontal max and every full window max are descriptive extras; primary unchanged
protocol.time_basis: independently audited bag custom GPS week and raw-text SOW; no assumed week
protocol.external_performance_scope: official public dataset literature may contain route tables; no local method performance or tuning before full freeze
protocol.figure_selection: all routes in fixed list order; first fixed event by order for any event trace, never chosen by accuracy
protocol.optional_rule: include building02 if five immutable originals pass official/hash/time/support audit and reused frontend/cache before collective freeze; no result-based inclusion
protocol.route_aggregation: equal-weight per-route event-macro RMSE, with all per-route values/negative evidence reported; never remove unfavorable routes
protocol.frontend_execution: one predetermined1x frontend per route, maximum2 isolated frontend processes; no cache selection by accuracy
protocol.reference_initialization: single earliest original reference row at/after max(reference first timestamp, first IMU, first valid causal GNSS, first primary LIO cache timestamp); selection uses timestamps/input validity only, never position error
protocol.reference_duplicate_policy: nondecreasing times allowed, stable first original row per timestamp, no smoothing or alignment
protocol.Clock2_comparison: same fixed good-duration2 qualification as P; show actual per-event clean and biased admission clocks, never assume equal observed delays
protocol.excluded_route_rule: if technical support fails before collective freeze, retain route and failure in report; no performance exclusion
protocol.paper_primary_table_selection: P, Clock2, no-anchor, NIS30, Huber2.5, Clock90 plus strongest qualified non-P if absent; full19 biased values/all complete raw records remain visible
protocol.whole_route_expected_grid: 10Hz integer ticks over [earliest common reference initialization, min(reference end, ADIS text end, single primary LIO cache timestamp end)]; endpoint support decided from timestamps before precision, no internal/successful intersection or per-method crop
protocol.positive_effect_supported_scope: registered joint service/natural/coverage superiority against every qualified fixed control plus material/attribution review; descriptive Clock2/no-anchor contrasts retained separately

protocol.reference_epoch_rule: single earliest original reference row at/after max(reference first timestamp, first IMU, first valid causal GNSS, first primary LIO cache timestamp); selection uses timestamps/input validity only, never position error
protocol.position_source: latest valid F9P at or before initial epoch, propagated with given initial velocity to epoch; subtract rotated antenna lever once
protocol.evaluation_alignment: one shared fixed translation from the predetermined initial reference position; no method-specific or trajectory fitting
protocol.common_outer_start: reference initial epoch; interpolate LIO at that epoch only after available scan endpoint, declare bounded delay
protocol.KF_GINS_initial_epoch: first IMU epoch at or after reference epoch; record offset; advance given initial position by initial velocity times offset
protocol.heldout_rule: unchanged numerical initialization/lever/STD; single predetermined common-covered state; performance prohibited until collective source/config/input freeze pushed and exact remote verification
protocol.GNSS_invalid_rule: reject nonfinite or nonpositive receiver standard deviations; retain reason and original row ID
protocol.imu_noise_source: fixed i2Nav-Robot-Baseline IC-GVINS gvins_i2nav.yaml 6c602f8d974fbe5be1183771541c90057e9e3bb6; transferred engineering priors, not fitted ADIS noise identification
protocol.scale_prior_note: 300ppm Gauss-Markov std is a declared project approximation for KF-GINS scale states, absent in upstream GVINS config; requires bounded sensitivity before strong-baseline status
protocol.reference_row_selection: single earliest original reference row at/after max(reference first timestamp, first IMU, first valid causal GNSS, first primary LIO cache timestamp); selection uses timestamps/input validity only, never position error
protocol.duplicate_reference_rule: nondecreasing times allowed, stable first original row per timestamp, no smoothing or alignment

input_identity.shutdown_clock_policy: advance clock only after EOF to wake Rate.sleep; no sensor messages

frontend.quaternion_policy: explicit normalization only for six-decimal serialization error <=2e-6
frontend.availability_policy: max(scan_end, sampled_ROS_clock+one_10ms_clock_tick), cumulative maximum; replay clock resolution bound, not measured field latency
frontend.health_diagnostic: effective point count and mean absolute plane residual, not increment covariance

frontend_processing_ms.scope: native t5-t0: IMU processing through incremental map; excludes input preprocessing/callback publication and wait; bag replay wall time reported separately

native_KF_protocol.run_scope: one natural run, independent GNSS/INS comparator only

scientific_scope: one new route under fixed artificial stress and natural receiver data; route event correlation/reference sharing/frontend repeat issue disclosed; no automatic novelty, universal gain or field fault probability
